method: Independent current-source audit after reading AGENTS.md. All 50 src/runtime files were read in full for manual semantic review of admission, final-write ownership fences, process lifecycle and cleanup proofs, delivery classification, history/continuation races, authorization and validation, attachment durability, bounded resource handling, workspace witness transactions, OAuth/private-result ownership and recovery. All 70 runtime TS/MJS test/support files were parsed from current source with the installed TypeScript AST API; the complete extracted test declarations, direct and extended assertions (including poll/soft), condition expressions, hooks, imports, identified side-effect calls, loop headers and finally blocks were reviewed statically. Eighteen higher-risk test files and ten support fixtures were additionally read in full; the README and fixture JSON were fully read. Historical measurements stated inside current documentation were treated only as claims and were not reused as evidence or test passes. The 1362 generated protocol files were NOT manually read line-by-line: the locally cached official 0.164.0-win32-x64 npm tarball was independently SHA-512 checked against live registry metadata, its executable extracted to a new isolated evidence directory, version-checked, and both experimental JSON and TypeScript protocols regenerated under a fresh CODEX_HOME; every output byte and the exact generated path set matched the frozen protocol files. Reference contract/provenance documents were reviewed against these current observations. No tests, paid inference, account login, personal credential access, production deployment or retired-host access were performed. No product files were changed. All 1486 assigned file hashes were compared with the frozen inventory at the beginning and end; a final source snapshot and independent SHA-256 comparison across all 1880 frozen source files confirmed the unchanged digest.

timing.note: startedAt is the first recorded UTC clock anchor after the preparatory AGENTS.md read, before the coverage inspection; completedAt is generated when this report is written.

limitations: Static review and schema regeneration do not establish live commercial provider behavior or platform acceptance.
AST static coverage of all tests is distinguished from full manual source reading of the listed high-risk tests.
